spans.s: पत् vt. or vi. 1P (pp. पतित; pres. पतति; caus. पतयति, पातयति; desid. पित्सति, पिपतिषति) 1. To fly, to move through the air, हंतुं कलहकारोऽसौ शब्दकारः पपात खम् Bt.v.100; 2. to move downwards, to alight, (रेणुः) पतति परिणतारुणप्रकाशः शलभसमूह इवाश्रमद्रुमेषु Sak.i.; 3. to set, to sink, सोऽयं चंद्रः पतति गगनादल्पशेषैर्मयूखैः Sak.iv.; 4. to throw oneself down, to cast oneself at, आत्मानं ते चरणपतितं यावदिच्छामि कर्तुम् Megh.ii.42; 5. to fall, to occur, to take place, e.g. लक्ष्मीर्यत्र पतंति तत्र विवृतद्वारा इव व्यापदः; 6. to come down, to descend, to fall down, to drop down, भानुरप्यपतिष्यत्क्ष्माम् Bt.xxi.6, अवाङ्मुखस्योपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात विद्याधरहस्तमुक्ता R.ii.60, Megh.ii.9; 7. to lose caste, to forfeit rank or position, to be degraded, पतंति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिंडोदकक्रियाः Bg.i.41; 8. to be reduced to poor circumstances, प्रायः कंदुकपातेन पतत्यार्यः पतन्नपि Bhartr.ii.(misc.)13; 9. to be directed to, to fall upon, प्रसादसौम्यानि सतां सुहृज्जने पतंति चक्षूंषि न दारुणः शराः Sak.vi., Megh.ii.18; 10. to fall to one’s share.With अनु-, 1. to fly to; 2. to run, to run on, मुहुरनुपतति स्यंदने दत्तदृष्टिः Sak.i.With अभि-, 1. to fly near, to hasten near; 2. to assail; 3. to overtake in flying.With अभ्युद्-, to fall upon, to attack.With आ-, 1. to fly towards, to rush in or on; 2. to happen, to occur, to befall, e.g. द्वयोरैक्यमापतितम्, or अहो न शोभनमापतितम्; 3. to assail; 4. to approach.With उद्-, 1. to fly up, to jump up, स्थानादस्मात् सरसनिचुलादुत्पतोदङ्मुखः खम् Megh.i.14, K.S.vi.36, Sis.ix.15; 2. to rise, to originate, to be produced, अप्सु निर्मथनादेव रसात्तस्माद्वरस्त्रियः Ram. With नि-, 1. to fly down, to fall upon, to descend, to alight, Bt.xv.27; 2. to throw oneself down, देवास्तदंते हरमूढभार्यं किरीटबद्धांजलयो निपत्य K.S.viii.62; 3. to assault, to assail, to fall upon, सिंहो शिशुरपि निपतति मदमलिनकपोलभित्तिषु गजेषु Bhartr.ii.38; 4. to fall into, to become fixed in, R.x.26; 5. to be directed to or towards, R.vi.7; 6. to happen, to occur, to take place.With निस्-, to issue from, to come out of, to fly out of, एषा विदूरीभवतः समुद्रात्सकानना निष्पततीव भूमिः R.xiii.18, Megh.ii.6.With परा-, to return, to arrive.With परि-, 1. to fly round or about, to hover about, e.g. परिपतति शिखी भ्रांतिमद्वारियंत्रम्; 2. to run in all directions; 3. to attack, to fall upon, क्रोधांधे च वृकोदरे परिपतत्याजौ कुतः संशयः Ve.vi.With प्र-, 1. to fly, to fly about; 2. to come down, to fall down, to fall away from.With प्रणि-, to salute, to bow (used with a dat. or acc., e.g. तस्मै or तं प्रणितस्य).With प्रोद्-, to fly into.With सम्-, 1. to fly together, to meet together; 2. to assail, to attack; 3. to go or roam about; 4. to happen.
पत m. 1. Flying, flight; 2. falling, alighting.
पात (I) a. (f. ता) Protected, preserved.

पात (II) m. 1. Flying, flight; 2. alighting, descending; 3. falling, fall, downfall, K.S.ii.41, R.xi.92; 4. a stroke (as in खड्गपात); 5. shedding, discharging, emitting, (as in असृक्पात), M.viii.44; 6. an attack, an inroad; 7. happening, coming to pass; 8. failing, defect; 9. an epithet of Rāhu; 10. destruction, dissolution, K.S.iii.44.
पात (I) a. (f. ता) Protected, preserved.
पत-ग m. a binl, M.vii.23.
पतंग (I) m. 1. a bird; 2. the sun, प्रभा पतंगस्य मुनेश्च धेनुः R.ii.15, Sis.i.12; 3. a grasshopper, पतंगवद्वह्निमुखं विविक्षुः K.S.iii.64, iv.20.
पतंग (II) n. 1. quick-silver; 2. a kind of sandal.
पतंगम m. 1. a bird; 2. a grasshopper.
पतंगिका f. 1. a small bird; 2. a kind of small bee.
पतंगिन् m. a bird.
पतंचिका f. A bowstring.
पतंजलि m. 1. Name of the celebrated author of the Mahābhāshya, a commentary on Pāṇini’s sūtras; 2. name of a philosopher, the propounder of the yoga philosophy.
पातंजल (I) a. (f. ली) Composed by Patanjali, पातंजले महाभाष्ये कृतभूरिपरिश्रमः Nāgojībhaṭṭa.
पतत् (I) a. (f. न्ती) Flying, alighting, coming down &c.
पतत् (II) m. A bird, क्वचित्पथा संचरते सुराणां क्वचिद्घनानां पततां क्वचिच्च R.xiii.19, Sis.ix.15.
पतत् (I) a. (f. न्ती) Flying, alighting, coming down &c.
पतत्-ग्रह m. 1. the reserve of an army; 2. a spitting-pot.
पतत्-भीरु m. a hawk, a falcon.
पतत्र n. 1. A wing, a pinion; 2. a vehicle.
पतत्रि m. A bird.
पतत्रिन् m. 1. A bird, R.viii.56, ix.27, K.S.v.4; 2. an arrow; 3. a horse.
पतत्रिन्-केतन m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पतन n. 1. The act of flying down, alighting, descending; 2. setting; 3. apostacy; 4. decline, adversity, ruin, ग्रहाधीना नरेंद्राणामुच्छ्रायाः पतनानि च Yaj.i.308.
पत्तन n. A town, a city, किं सति पत्तने ग्रामे रत्नपरीक्षा Mal.i. (Cf. पट्टन.)
पातन n. 1. Causing to fall, bringing down; 2. lowering, humbling.(दंडस्य पातनम् ‘causing the rod to fall, i.e. beating’; गर्भस्य पातनम् ‘causing the fœtus to fall, i.e. causing an abortion.’)
पतनीय n. A degrading sin.
पतम m. 1. The moon; 2. a bird; 3. a grasshopper.
पतम m. 1. The moon; 2. a bird; 3. a grasshopper.
पतयालु a. Prone to fall.
पताका f. 1. A flag, a banner; 2. a flag-staff; 3. a sign, a mark, a symbol; 4. an episode in a drama; (See पताकास्थानक); 5. good fortune, good luck, auspiciousness.
पातक m.n. Sin, crime, Bg.i.37; (according to law-givers, there are five great sins- ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः । महांति पातकान्याहुः संसर्गश्चापि तैस्सह M.xi.54).
पताका-अंशुक n. a flag.
पताका-स्थानक n. intimation of a subordinate incident (in dramaturgy); (यत्रार्थे चिंतितेऽन्यास्मिंस्तल्लिंगोऽनः प्रयुज्यते । आगंतुकेन भावेन पताकास्थानकं तु तत्).
पताकिक a. (f. का) Having or carrying a banner.
पताकिक a. (f. का) Having or carrying a banner.
पताकिन् m. 1. A flag; 2. a standard-bearer.
पताकिनी f. An army, Kir.xiv.27.
पति m. 1. A master, a lord; 2. a proprietor; 3. governor, ruler, one who presides over, M.vii.115; 4. a husband, पतिः प्रतीतः प्रसवोन्मुखीं प्रियां ददर्श काले दिवमभ्रितामेव R.iii.12.
पत्ति (I) m. 1. A footman, a foot-soldier; 2. a pedestrian; 3. a hero.
पत्ति (II) f. 1. A small division of an army consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horsemen and five foot-soldiers; 2. going, walking.
पति-घातिनी, -घ्नी f. a woman who murders her husband.
पति-घातिनी, -घ्नी f. a woman who murders her husband.
पति-देवता, -देवा f. a chaste woman, one solely devoted to her husband, तामलभंत पतिं पतिदेवताः शिखरिणामिवं सागरमापगाः R.ix.17, धुरि स्थिथा त्वं पतिदेवतानाम् xiv.74.
पति-देवता, -देवा f. a chaste woman, one solely devoted to her husband, तामलभंत पतिं पतिदेवताः शिखरिणामिवं सागरमापगाः R.ix.17, धुरि स्थिथा त्वं पतिदेवतानाम् xiv.74.
पति-धर्म m. duty towards a husband.
पति-लोक m. the world of husbands in a future life.
पति-मती, -वत्नी f. a wife whose husband is living, R.xv.35.
पति-मती, -वत्नी f. a wife whose husband is living, R.xv.35.
पतिंवरा f. a woman going to choose a husband.
पति-व्रता f. a devoted and virtuous wife.
पति-व्रता˚त्व n. fidelity to a husband.
पति-सेवा f. devotion to a husband.
पतित a. (f. ता) 1. Fallen, alighted; 2. dropped; 3. defeated, overthrown; 4. degraded; 5. fallen (morally), (pp. of पत् q.v.).
पतित a. (f. ता) 1. Fallen, alighted; 2. dropped; 3. defeated, overthrown; 4. degraded; 5. fallen (morally), (pp. of पत् q.v.).
पातित a. (f. ता) 1. Cast down, struck down, Bhartr.ii.85; 2. overthrown, humbled.
पातित a. (f. ता) 1. Cast down, struck down, Bhartr.ii.85; 2. overthrown, humbled.
पतेर m. 1. A bird; 2. a hole, a pit.
पत्ति-काय m. infantry.
पत्ति-संहति f. a body of infantry.
पत्तिन् m. A foot-soldier, a footman.
पातिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Going to, alighting on; 2. falling, sinking; 3. pouring forth, discharging.

पत्र n. 1. The wing of a bird; 2. the feather of an arrow, R.ii.31; 3. a vehicle in general, R.xv.48; 4. the leaf of a tree, R.iii.7; 5. the leaf of a flower, ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया शमीलता छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यवस्यंति Sak.i.; 6. a leaf for writing, paper; 7. a letter; 8. the blade of a weapon; 9. painting the person as a decoration, R.xiii.45; 10. a knife, a dagger.

पात्र n. 1. A drinking vessel, a cup, a jar; 2. a vessel in general, R.ii.21, Yaj.i.183; 3. the channel of a river; 4. a receptacle of any kind; 5. a fit or worthy person; 6. a person worthy to receive gifts, गोभूतिलहिरण्यानि पात्रे दातव्यमार्चितम् Yaj.i.201, Bg.xvii.22; 7. a king’s minister; 8. an actor, dramatis persona, तत्प्रतिपात्रमाधीयतां यत्नः Sak.i.; 9. fitness, propriety; 10. a reservoir.
पत्र-अंग n. the bhūrja tree.
पत्र-अंगुलि f. drawing figures on the person with coloured sandal or any other substance.
पत्र-अंजन n. ink.
पत्र-आवलि f. 1. red chalk; 2. a row of leaves; 3. painting the person as a decoration.
पत्र-आवली f. 1. a row of leaves; 2. painting the person with coloured substances as a decoration.
पत्र-रेखा, -लेखा, -वल्लरी, -वल्लि, -वल्ली f. See पत्रभंग.
पत्र-रेखा, -लेखा, -वल्लरी, -वल्लि, -वल्ली f. See पत्रभंग.
पत्र-आहार m. feeding on leaves.
पत्र-ऊर्ण n. a silk-garment, स्नानीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्रोर्णमुपयुज्यते Mal.v.
पत्र-काहला f. the noise made by the rustling of leaves or by the flapping of wings.
पत्र-दारक m. a saw.
पत्र-नाडिका f. the fibre of a leaf.
पत्र-परशु m. a file.
पत्र-पाल m. a large knife.
पात्र-पाल m. the rod of a balance.
पत्र-पाली f. a pair of scissors.
पत्र-पाश्या f. an ornament to be worn on the forehead.
पत्र-पुट n. A vessel of leaves.
पत्र-बाल, -वाल m. an oar.
पत्र-बाल, -वाल m. an oar.
पत्र-भंग m. drawing figures on the person with fragrant and coloured substances as an ornament, कस्तूरीवरपत्रभंगनिकरो मृष्टो न गंडस्थले Sr.
पत्र-भंगि f. drawing figures on the person with fragrant and coloured substances as an ornament, कस्तूरीवरपत्रभंगनिकरो मृष्टो न गंडस्थले Sr.
पत्र-भंगी f. drawing figures on the person with fragrant and coloured substances as an ornament, कस्तूरीवरपत्रभंगनिकरो मृष्टो न गंडस्थले Sr.
पत्र-यौवन n. a young leaf.
पत्र-रथ m. a bird.
पत्र-रथ˚इंद्र m. an epithet of Garuḍa.
पत्र-रथ˚इंद्रकेतु m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, R.xviii.30.
पत्र-रेखा, -लेखा, -वल्लरी, -वल्लि, -वल्ली f. See पत्रभंग.
पत्र-रेखा, -लेखा, -वल्लरी, -वल्लि, -वल्ली f. See पत्रभंग.
पत्र-रेखा, -लेखा, -वल्लरी, -वल्लि, -वल्ली f. See पत्रभंग.
पत्र-वाज a. furnished with feathers (as an arrow).
पत्र-वाह m. 1. a bird; 2. an arrow; 3. a letter-carrier.
पत्र-विशेषक m. See पत्रभंग, R.ix.29, iii.55, K.S.iii.33.
पत्र-वेष्ट m. a kind of ear-ring, R.xvi.67.
पत्र-शाक m. vegetable consisting chiefly of leaves.
पत्र-सूचि f. a thorn.
पत्र-हिम n. wintry or snowy weather.
पत्रक n. 1. A leaf; 2. painting figures on the body as a decoration.
पत्रणा f. 1. Painting figures on the body as a decoration; 2. feathering an arrow.
पत्रिका f. 1. A leaf for writing upon; 2. a letter.
पात्रिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Measured out with any vessel; 2. fit, adequate, appropriate.
पात्रिक (II) n. A vessel, a cup, a dish.
पत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Winged, feathered; 2. having leaves.
पत्रिन् (II) m. 1. An arrow, R.iii.56; 2. a bird, R.xi.29; 3. a falcon; 4. a tree; 5. a mountain; 6. a chariot.
पत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Winged, feathered; 2. having leaves.
पत्रिन्-वाह m. a bird.
पत्नी f. A wife, R.i.31, 47, 81.
पत्नी-आट m. women’s apartments.
पत्नी-सन्नहन n. the girdle of a wife.
पत्सल m. A way, a road.
पद्-काषिन् m. a footman.
पातंगि m. 1. An epithet of Saturn; 2. of Yama; 3. of Karṇa; 4. of Sugrīva.
पातंजल (I) a. (f. ली) Composed by Patanjali, पातंजले महाभाष्ये कृतभूरिपरिश्रमः Nāgojībhaṭṭa.
पातंजल (II) n. The Yoga system of philosophy taught by Patanjali. (It is an open question whether the author of the Mahabhashva was identical with this Patanjali.)

पाताल n. 1. The last of the seven regions under the earth tenanted by Nāgas (the seven regions are- अतल, वितल, सुतल, रसातल, तलातल, महातल and पाताल.), R.i.80; 2. the lower world generally, R.xv.84; 3. an excavation, a hole; 4. submarine fire.
पाताल-गंगा f. the Ganges of the lower world.
पाताल-ओकस्, -निलय, -निवास, -वासिन् m. 1. a demon; 2. a serpent-demon (नाग).
पाताल-ओकस्, -निलय, -निवास, -वासिन् m. 1. a demon; 2. a serpent-demon (नाग).

पाताल-ओकस्, -निलय, -निवास, -वासिन् m. 1. a demon; 2. a serpent-demon (नाग).
पातिक m. The Gangetic porpoise.
पातित्य n. Loss of caste or position.

पातिली f. 1. A snare; 2. a small earthen vessel.
पातुक (I) a. (f. की) Falling frequently.

पात्र-उपकरण n. decorations of an inferior sort.

पात्र-संस्कार m. 1. the cleaning of a vessel; 2. the current of a river.

पात्रिय a. (f. या) Worthy to partake of a meal.
पात्रिय a. (f. या) Worthy to partake of a meal.
पात्रीय n. A sacrificial vessel.
